description: Visual identity carried over from the printed Quest Log package. Reuse these so the web app feels like the same product as the wall posters and cards.

typography.display_font: Poppins (700/600 weight) — headers, XP numbers, rank names, badge names
typography.body_font: system-ui sans-serif or 'Nunito Sans' — body text, exercise lists
typography.notes: Headers are bold and chunky. Numbers (XP, reps, session counts) are always bold and prominent — they're the reward feedback.

motifs.background: Dark navy 'night sky' header bands with a thin gold rule underneath, small white 4-point stars scattered as accents.
motifs.cards: Rounded corners (8-14px), soft cream backgrounds, dashed borders on anything meant to feel like a printable/cut-out.
motifs.badges: Circular medallion coins with a colored ring, radial-gradient face, dashed inner ring, and a bold flat-icon silhouette in the center. Assets already produced — see assets/badges/.
motifs.progress: Rank progress shown as a filled meter/pip trail (see rank_meter concept in reference PDFs), not a plain percentage bar — it should feel like a game HUD.
motifs.iconography_rule: Original space / fantasy-adventurer / blocky-world vibes only. No actual Star Wars, Lord of the Rings, or Minecraft characters, logos, or trademarked imagery, anywhere in the app — including AI-generated icons, emoji choices, or copy.
